parts.title: Goal
text: A chatbot that runs locally and answers questions based on information I provided.

parts.title: LangChain + llama.cpp
text: After some research, I decided to combine LangChain with llama.cpp to run the LLM locally.
llama.cpp uses the quantized GGUF model format, which makes it possible to run the model on a CPU instead of a GPU.

parts.title: ChromaDB
text: The bot's knowledge is stored in ChromaDB, a vector database that turns text into embeddings. When the user sends a message, it is converted into a vector as well, and ChromaDB searches for similar entries.
The closest matches are then added to the prompt, so the model can generate an answer based on the provided information.

parts.title: Flask
text: Flask exposes the chatbot as an HTTP service.
